* Listener to be notified when the set of controllable {@link WindowInsetsCompat.Type} * controlled by a {@link WindowInsetsController} changes. *

* Once a {@link WindowInsetsCompat.Type} becomes controllable, the app will be able to * control the window that is causing this type of insets by calling * {@link #controlWindowInsetsAnimation}. *

* Note: When listening to cancellability of the {@link WindowInsets.Type#ime}, * {@link #controlWindowInsetsAnimation} may still fail in case the {@link InputMethodService} * decides to cancel the show request. This could happen when there is a hardware keyboard * attached. * * @see #addOnControllableInsetsChangedListener( *WindowInsetsControllerCompat.OnControllableInsetsChangedListener) * @see #removeOnControllableInsetsChangedListener( *WindowInsetsControllerCompat.OnControllableInsetsChangedListener)

methods.name: void onControllableInsetsChanged(@NonNull WindowInsetsControllerCompat controller, @InsetsType int typeMask)
methods.comment:
* Called when the set of controllable {@link WindowInsetsCompat.Type} changes.
         *
         * @param controller The controller for which the set of controllable
         *                   {@link WindowInsetsCompat.Type}s
         *                   are changing.
         * @param typeMask   Bitwise behavior type-mask of the {@link WindowInsetsCompat.Type}s
         *                   the controller is currently able to control.

methodNames: void onControllableInsetsChanged(@NonNull WindowInsetsControllerCompat controller, @InsetsType int typeMask)
